title_ar: الشيخ الددو يفتتح برنامجه العلمي باسطنبول بدورة في أصول الفقه
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Opens His Scholarly Programme in Istanbul with a Course in Legal Theory
body_ar:
افتتح صباح اليوم السبت 16 رجب 1437هـ الموافق 23 ابريل 2016م بالعاصمة التركية اسطنبول فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو حفظه الله تعالى رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء ورئيس جامعة عبد الله بن ياسين برنامجه العلمي بدورة في أًصول الفقه " شرح كتاب " مفتاح الوصول إلى بناء الفروع على الأصول لمؤلفه محمد بن أحمد الحسني التلمساني ، و قد تحدث فضيلته عن أهمية أصول الفقه و مكانته في التشريع الاسلامي باعتباره يشمل على أغلب مصادر التشريع من الاجماع و القياس و ينظم طرق الاستنباط ، متحدثا عن أبرز رجالات هذا الفن و الكتب المؤلفة فيه وذلك قبل شرحه لمتن الكتاب و التعليق عليه ..

وتستمر الدورة لمدة ثلاثة أيام، يكون للشيخ خلالها أنشطة أخرى خارج الدورة من بنيها محاضرة بعنوان: "الشمائل المحمدية"، مساء السبت في مقر وقف دار السلام باسطنبول.
body_en:
This Saturday morning, 16 Rajab 1437 AH, corresponding to 23 April 2016, in the Turkish capital Istanbul, His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew (may God the Exalted preserve him), president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars and president of Abdullah ibn Yasin University, opened his scholarly programme with a course in legal theory (uṣūl al-fiqh): a commentary on the book Miftāḥ al-Wuṣūl ilā Bināʾ al-Furūʿ ʿalā al-Uṣūl ('The Key to Building the Subsidiary Rulings upon the Principles') by its author Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Hasani al-Tilimsani. His Eminence spoke about the importance of legal theory and its standing in Islamic legislation, in that it takes in most of the sources of law — scholarly consensus (ijmāʿ) and analogical reasoning (qiyās) — and regulates the methods of deriving rulings; and he spoke about the foremost men of this discipline and the books written in it, before expounding the text of the book and commenting upon it…

The course runs for three days, during which the Sheikh will have other activities outside it, among them a lecture entitled 'The Noble Qualities of Muhammad (al-Shamāʾil al-Muḥammadiyyah)', on Saturday evening at the premises of the Dar al-Salam endowment (waqf) in Istanbul.

flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT, recorded not fixed: 'يشمل على' is a solecism for 'يشتمل على'. Substantively, listing only ijmāʿ and qiyās as 'most of the sources' is the reporter's compression, not a considered statement of the sources of law; the English does not tidy it into a fuller list the Sheikh did not give.

translator_notes: A news report written by the site; the Sheikh's remarks are reported indirectly and the English keeps that indirection.
SOURCE DEFECTS preserved in body_ar: 'أًصول' carries a stray tanwīn mark; the opening quotation mark before 'شرح كتاب' is unclosed; 'بنيها' stands for 'بينها'.

Miftāḥ al-Wuṣūl is the well-known Maliki uṣūl work of al-Sharif al-Tilimsani (d. 771/1370). The source gives the author as محمد بن أحمد الحسني التلمساني and the English reproduces that without correcting or expanding it.
The first paragraph breaks off with '..' in the source; the English ends where the Arabic ends.
The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date, not the date of composition.
